name: truco-arena-demo
description: Truco Arena local: memoria o MariaDB provisional; B1–B4 pendientes.

scripts.test:sql: npm run build --workspace backend && node --env-file=backend/.env.mariadb node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs --test --test-concurrency=1 backend/test/sql-integration.test.ts backend/test/sql-combat.test.ts
scripts.build: npm run catalog:check && npm run build --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run catalog:check && npm run test --workspace backend && npm run test --workspace frontend
scripts.test:e2e:sql: npm run build --workspace backend && playwright test --config playwright.sql.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run build && npm test && npm run test:build && npm run test:e2e
